company.name: Alchemize
company.shortDescription: Alchemize provides an AI-native customs brokerage platform that automates international trade compliance workflows.
company.description: Alchemize provides an AI-native customs brokerage platform that replaces manual customs processes with automated, software-driven workflows. The company combines licensed customs brokerage expertise with AI agents that execute custom operating procedures and escalation paths. Its platform automates entry filings, compliance lookups, and product classifications while answering complex international trade regulatory questions. Alchemize offers visibility into shipping documentation, status updates, and handoffs across the customs clearance process. The service is designed for importers and supply chain operators that manage large volumes of cross-border shipments. By reducing hand-keyed data entry and slow back-and-forth communications, Alchemize supports faster customs clearance and more consistent compliance outcomes.

productsAndServices.description: An AI-enabled customs brokerage platform that automates entry filings, compliance workflows, and trade regulatory queries for importers.
